# Create data model comparison plot for Nepal

simulate_model_for_plot <- function(local_test_params){
  simulated_data_long <- list()
  WF_PPxSero <- odin.dust::odin_dust("NFDS_Model_PPxSero.R")
  WFmodel_ppxSero <- WF_PPxSero$new(pars = local_test_params,
                           time = 0,
                           n_particles = 10L,
                           n_threads = 4L,
                           seed = 1L, deterministic = FALSE) # I think running this deterministically makes no sense # I need the variance
  for (i in 1:7) {
    simMean_all <- rowMeans(WFmodel_ppxSero$run(i*12)[-(1:(local_test_params$species_no+1)),])
    simMean_matrix <- matrix(simMean_all, ncol = local_test_params$sero_no, nrow = local_test_params$species_no, byrow = FALSE)
    simulated_data_long[[i]] <- simMean_matrix
  }
  simulated_data_over_time_clust <- sapply(simulated_data_long, rowSums)
  simulated_data_over_time_clust
}

simulate_model_for_plot2 <- function(Nepal_mcmc_run, Nepal_params_loc){
  simulated_data_long <- list()
  rand_ind <- sample(x = 1:nrow(Nepal_mcmc_run), size = 100, replace = FALSE)
  WF_PPxSero <- odin.dust::odin_dust("NFDS_Model_PPxSero.R")
  
  empty_vec <- rep(0,Nepal_params_loc$species_no)
  cluster_samples_ParamVar <- array(rep(empty_vec,length(rand_ind)),dim = c(length(rand_ind),Nepal_params_loc$species_no))
  
  for (i in 1:length(rand_ind)) {
    pars <- Nepal_mcmc_run[rand_ind[i],4:7]
    Nepal_params_loc$sigma_f <- pars[1]
    Nepal_params_loc$prop_f <- pars[2]
    Nepal_params_loc$m <- pars[3]
    Nepal_params_loc$v <- pars[4]
    
    WFmodel_ppxSero <- WF_PPxSero$new(pars = Nepal_params_loc,
                           time = 0,
                           n_particles = 1L,
                           n_threads = 4L,
                           seed = 1L)
    cluster_samples_ParamVar[i,] <- (WFmodel_ppxSero$run(7*12)[(2:(Nepal_params_loc$species_no+1)),])
  }
  cluster_samples_ParamVar
}

simulate_model_for_plot2_null <- function(Nepal_mcmc_run, Nepal_params_loc){
  simulated_data_long <- list()
  rand_ind <- sample(x = 1:nrow(Nepal_mcmc_run), size = 100, replace = FALSE)
  WF_PPxSero <- odin.dust::odin_dust("NFDS_Model_PPxSero.R")
  
  empty_vec <- rep(0,Nepal_params_loc$species_no)
  cluster_samples_ParamVar <- array(rep(empty_vec,length(rand_ind)),dim = c(length(rand_ind),Nepal_params_loc$species_no))
  
  for (i in 1:length(rand_ind)) {
    pars <- Nepal_mcmc_run[rand_ind[i],4:5]
    Nepal_params_loc$m <- pars[1]
    Nepal_params_loc$v <- pars[2]
    
    WFmodel_ppxSero <- WF_PPxSero$new(pars = Nepal_params_loc,
                           time = 0,
                           n_particles = 1L,
                           n_threads = 4L,
                           seed = 1L)
    cluster_samples_ParamVar[i,] <- (WFmodel_ppxSero$run(7*12)[(2:(Nepal_params_loc$species_no+1)),])
  }
  cluster_samples_ParamVar
}

for (i in 1:length(unique(seq_clusters$GPSC))) {
  count_vts <- 0
  count_in_cluster <- length(which(seq_clusters$GPSC == unique(seq_clusters$GPSC)[i]))
  for (j in which(seq_clusters$GPSC == unique(seq_clusters$GPSC)[i])) {
    if(seq_clusters$VT[j] == "VT"){
      count_vts <- count_vts + 1
    }
  }
  if(count_vts == count_in_cluster){
    Nepal_cluster_VTs[i] <- "VT"
  } else if(count_vts == 0){
    Nepal_cluster_VTs[i] <- "NVT"
  } else{
    Nepal_cluster_VTs[i] <- "mixed"
  }
}
